Mailtabs by EvoSoft puts Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP inbox in one place, sorted into tabs you design. Try the live demo with a test account.
Every inbox in one place, in tabs you design.
Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo or any IMAP account and sort all of it into tabs built from accounts and rules. A complete mail client, not just a reader.

Mailtabs is a self-hosted mail client for people with too many inboxes. A tab is a set of accounts plus optional rules, so Work shows only work mail and Receipts collects every order confirmation across every account. Everything you do goes back to the real mailbox, so your phone stays in sync.

Check anything important with us directly. Don’t use it to send spam, to try to get around its rules, or to produce unlawful content.

The demos are provided so you can evaluate our software. All people, companies, emails and sales in them are fictional. The demo accounts are shared and the demos reset automatically, so don’t enter real personal information, passwords or payment details. Demos are provided as they are, may be unavailable at times, and may change without notice.
Don’t use the demos to attack, overload or misuse our servers, or to harm other visitors.
We link to client websites and other sites we don’t control. We’re not responsible for their content or their privacy practices.

We don’t sell anything on this website, and you can’t pay here. Prices, payment stages, cancellation and any refunds are set out in the written quote or contract for your project. If you are a consumer, you also keep any right to cancel that the law gives you, and your quote will explain it.

We’re not liable for loss caused by using this website, the chat assistant or the demos, or by their being unavailable, except where the law doesn’t allow liability to be limited, for example for death or personal injury, or for damage caused intentionally or through gross negligence. Nothing in these terms limits your rights as a consumer under the law that applies to you.

These terms are governed by the law of Georgia, and disputes go to the courts of Georgia. If you are a consumer living in the EU, you also keep the protection of the mandatory laws of your country and can bring a claim in its courts.

This policy explains what personal data this website and our live demos collect, why, and what you can do about it. {company} (see Who we are) is responsible for it. For any privacy question, email {email}.

When you send the quote form we receive your name, email address and message and, if you add them, your phone number, company, the services and timeline you picked, and the language of the page. We need your name, email and message to reply; the rest is optional. We use these details only to answer you and prepare the quote you asked for. The request is emailed to our mailbox, and a backup copy is kept on our web server in case the email fails.

Legal basis: steps you ask us to take before a possible contract or, if you write on behalf of a company, our legitimate interest in answering business enquiries (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) and (f), and the equivalent grounds in the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection). Emails and calls to us are handled the same way.

When the AI assistant is switched on, our server sends your conversation (your last messages and the assistant’s replies, up to 12 in all) and the page language to our AI provider, Anthropic, PBC, in the United States, which writes the answer. We don’t send your name, IP address or any other identifier, but whatever you type is sent as written, so please don’t include personal or sensitive details. We don’t store conversations on our server; your browser keeps the current one in the tab until you close it. When the AI is switched off, the assistant answers from built-in answers in your browser and nothing you type leaves your device. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in answering visitors’ questions.

To stop spam and limit the cost of the assistant, our server counts requests from each IP address. It stores only a one-way hash of the address, made with a key that changes every day and is then deleted, next to a counter, and it deletes counters older than two days automatically. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in keeping the site secure.

Like every website, our hosting provider records technical data about each request (IP address, time, page requested and browser type) to deliver the site and keep it secure, and deletes these logs after a limited period. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in keeping the site secure and working.

Pages that list our live demos check whether each demo is online, so your browser contacts our demo servers ({hosts}). Like any web server, they see your IP address and browser type. No cookies are sent with these checks. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in showing whether the demos are working and keeping them secure.

The demos run on our own servers with shared accounts and made-up data, so other visitors can see what you enter there. In the Evo demo that includes the location your device shares when you clock in, which happens only if you allow it in your browser. The demos delete everything at their automatic reset: Evo every 3 hours, Mailtabs every hour and StudyCat every night. Evo also keeps backups from before its last 5 resets, so its data is normally gone within about 15 hours. Please use only the demo accounts and don’t enter real personal information. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in letting you try our software; your location is used only if you choose to share it.

We don’t use analytics, advertising or social-media tracking of any kind, and our pages load no scripts, fonts, images or embeds from other companies. We don’t sell your data, and we don’t make automated decisions about you that have legal or similarly significant effects.
Our hosting provider, Hostinger, which runs this website and our mailbox.
Anthropic, PBC (USA), for the chat assistant’s answers. Under its commercial terms it doesn’t use them to train its models, and it keeps them only for a limited period.

Anthropic is in the United States. For transfers covered by the GDPR, we rely on Anthropic’s data processing addendum, which includes the EU standard contractual clauses. You can ask us for a copy.

Quote requests: the copy on our web server is deleted automatically {months} months after you send it. We delete the email the same way, unless the request leads to a project; then we keep what the contract and Georgian tax and accounting law require.
Chat: nothing on our server. Your browser deletes the conversation when you close the tab.
Server logs: the limited period set by our hosting provider.
Live demos: until the next automatic reset (Evo’s backups: normally within about 15 hours).

You can ask us whether we hold data about you and for a copy of it. You can also ask us to correct it, delete it, limit how we use it or send it to you in a portable format, and you can object to any use based on our legitimate interests. Email {email}; we reply within 10 working days.

If you think we’ve handled your data wrongly, please tell us first. You can also complain to the Personal Data Protection Service of Georgia ({pdps}). If you live in the EU or EEA, you can also complain to the data protection authority in your country.
We update this policy when what we do with data changes. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version.

This website doesn’t use cookies, analytics, advertising or tracking tools. It saves a few small items in your own browser: the language you pick, your current chat, whether the assistant’s AI is available, and a note that the chat greeting has already been shown. They hold no identifier, are used only for these features and stay in your browser (apart from the chat messages you decide to send), so under EU rules they don’t need your consent.
What this website saves in your browser
You can delete these items at any time in your browser’s site settings. The site works without them.

Our live demos are separate websites. When you sign in to one, it sets a sign-in cookie, and the Evo demo also remembers a device that has signed in before, to slow down password guessing. These cookies are needed for the demos to work.
If we ever add anything that needs your consent, such as analytics, we’ll ask first and update this page.
